mainEntity.name: Are zebra blinds the same as roller shades?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Both use a rolling mechanism, but zebra blinds use alternating sheer and opaque bands, while roller shades usually use a single continuous fabric panel.

mainEntity.name: Do zebra blinds block light completely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard zebra blinds soften and control light, but they usually do not create full blackout. For strong room darkening, blackout fabric is usually a better option.

mainEntity.name: Are roller shades good for modern interiors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Roller shades are often used in modern interiors because their form is simple, clean and visually quiet.
Yes. Many roller shade fabrics can be used for custom printing, depending on fabric type, print method and artwork quality.

mainEntity.name: Do blackout blinds make a room completely dark?

acceptedAnswer.text: They can significantly reduce light, but complete darkness also depends on installation, edge gaps and the amount of window coverage.
Yes. Blackout fabrics are often used with motorized roller systems, especially for bedrooms, meeting rooms and media spaces.

mainEntity.name: Can any image be used for printed blinds?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. The image needs enough resolution and the right proportions for the final blind size.

mainEntity.name: What matters most before ordering printed blinds?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accurate measurement, correct artwork size and a suitable fabric are the most important factors.
